title: Project Continue Dispatcher Request Envelope v1
description: Transport-neutral, versioned request envelope. All identity, idempotency, repository, immutable revision and time-bound fields are mandatory. This schema validates structure only; it does not authorize or execute a task. The dispatcher must treat all supplied values as untrusted input.

request_id.description: Globally unique UUID for one accepted request; duplicate request IDs must be rejected.

idempotency_key.description: Stable retry key, unique within actor + repository + task scope. Reuse with the same canonical payload returns the original result; reuse with a different payload must be rejected.

arguments.description: Task-specific data; a fixed task registry and per-task argument schemas must validate this before any handler is called.

issued_at.description: RFC 3339 date-time when the request was created.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 date-time deadline. Runtime validation must reject expired requests and require expires_at to be later than issued_at.
